prefixes.bugfix: Investigate or fix an unexpected failure or regression.
prefixes.feat: Design or implement a concrete new capability or enhancement.
prefixes.discuss: Explore options or make a decision without a primary implementation task.
prefixes.learn: Build understanding through explanation, reading, or practice.
prefixes.refactor: Change internal structure while preserving behavior.
prefixes.docs: Write or update documentation as the main deliverable.
prefixes.review: Evaluate a change, design, or deliverable and report findings.
prefixes.ops: Deploy, migrate, monitor, or operate a live system.
prefixes.chore: Perform routine maintenance, dependency, or tooling work.
